# Upstream files this fork modifies -- the single source of truth.
#
# Consumed by:
#   .github/workflows/build-release.yml   the set of PHP it lints before a release
#   .github/workflows/watch-upstream.yml  which patches an upstream release collides with
#
# Both used to carry their own hardcoded copy of this list. They disagreed: the
# watcher named seven files, the linter diffed against a commit that does not
# exist in this repository and so checked nothing at all. One list, read by
# both, is what stops them drifting apart again.
#
# Paths are relative to this repository's root. Upstream (Vateron-Media/XC_VM)
# keeps the same tree under `src/`, so the watcher prefixes `src/` before it
# compares. Everything else this fork adds lives in `Modules/flussonic_1f4a9/`,
# `build/` and `.github/`, which upstream never touches -- that is what keeps
# an upgrade cheap.
#
# Verified by byte comparison against upstream 2.3.9, with two corrections that
# a naive diff gets wrong:
#   * line endings are not changes. `* text=auto` in .gitattributes rewrites
#     CRLF on checkout, which makes ~200 untouched files look modified.
#   * Git LFS pointers are not changes. Public/assets/admin/videos/login-bg.mp4
#     is LFS upstream; a clone without LFS yields a 132-byte pointer. Our copy
#     matches its oid sha256 exactly, so it is NOT patched.
#
# Keep this list exact. build-release.yml fails the build if an entry here is
# missing from the tree, and a file patched but *not* listed here is one that
# an upstream upgrade can silently revert.


# --- Carry the fixes documented in build/HANDOFF.md -------------------------
# Reverting any of these puts the panel back in a state that looks installed
# and is not. Each was reproduced on the real server before being fixed.

Cli/Commands/StatusCommand.php
Core/Module/ModuleMigrator.php
Public/Views/admin/topbar.php
migrations/002_add_maxmind_cron.sql
migrations/008_add_module_updates_cron.sql
migrations/009_add_proxy_cron.sql
service


# --- Only redirect the updater at this fork ---------------------------------
# GIT_OWNER_MAIN / GIT_OWNER_BIN and the repo names. No behaviour changes, so
# an upstream release touching these is cheap to re-apply.

Cli/Commands/BinariesCommand.php
Cli/Commands/LbInstallFlow.php
Cli/Commands/ServerInstallCommand.php
Cli/Commands/UpdateCommand.php
Cli/CronJobs/UpdateCronJob.php
Core/Config/AppConfig.php
Infrastructure/Bootstrap/WebApiBootstrap.php


# --- Drift captured from the running panel ----------------------------------
# Not a deliberate patch: the panel appends missing language keys at runtime
# with the key as its own value, and that edit came across when the source was
# captured. `mass_edit_mags` / `mass_edit_enigmas` are the navbar labels
# CoreNavbarProvider.php asks for and upstream's en.ini genuinely lacks -- it
# only defines the `permission_`-prefixed variants. Listed so the watcher
# reports it rather than letting an upgrade quietly drop it.

resources/langs/en.ini
